description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapana Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and cadastral information) in the Village of Ballapana Udabage. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlements, and property rights determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
